title: Oahu Majestic Circle Island Tour with Waimea Falls and Byodo Inn
includes: Round-trip hotel pickup and drop-off from Waikiki (selected hotels)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a change of clothes if you are thinking about taking a quick dip at Waimea Falls.
We intentionally only operate this tour using an air conditioned mini-bus to ensure that group sizes are kept small enough to enjoy each stop with your group and guide.
Admission to every stop has been taken care of, just bring cash for snacks and souvenirs.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Since 1974, E Noa Tours has specialized in showing visitors the real Oʻahu through immersive experiences led by passionate local guides. Our mission is simple: turn your day into unforgettable memories filled with Hawaiian history, culture, and natural wonder.

Everything you need is included: entrance to Byodo-In Temple ($10 value), full access to Waimea Valley with time to swim at the falls ($20 value), sit-down lunch at Pounders Restaurant or Tanaka Shrimp, and hotel pickup. 

You'll explore Byodo-In Temple's peaceful koi ponds and ring the sacred bell, walk through lush botanical gardens to Waimea Falls, stand at the dramatic Nuʻuanu Pali cliffs where Hawaiian legends were born, sample fresh macadamia nuts at Tropical Farms, and visit the iconic Dole Plantation, all while traveling comfortably with expert guides who bring each location to life through storytelling and deep cultural knowledge.

Perfect for first-time visitors and families seeking an authentic island experience.
